_about: Prompts for Egg karaoke (js/karaoke.js), generated with the ElevenLabs Sound Effects API by tools/gen-sounds.js --manifest tools/karaoke.json, then chosen, pitched and levelled by tools/pick-karaoke.js into sounds/karaoke/. inst = one note of each band instrument (the app pitches it to every note of the song); sing = each friend's sound in the band. A call that holds a clear pitch sings the tune (the song moves to its key); anything else is played as it is and never re-pitched, including the sound a friend with no call really makes (a shell knock, a sniff, a squelch, a bubble, a wing flutter, a foot thump). pick-karaoke.js decides which from the recording. 'take' pins a take, 'fromTake' ignores takes made before the prompt changed; extra = each friend's second sound, its ad-lib in the gaps. Every one has a synthesised fallback.
common: close-up, isolated, no music, no speech, no background noise
commonInst: one single isolated note, dry studio recording, no reverb, no other instruments, no melody
